articles.title: Probation staff vote for strike action in 'serious anger' over pay and workloads
articles.summary: Probation and family courts staff have voted in favour of strike action over pay and workloads.

articles.title: EU leaders choose team for Ukraine peace talks after months of wavering
articles.summary: British representatives will be part of a team representing Europe in Ukraine peace talks.

articles.title: US military responds to 'suspected unauthorised drone activity' at UK air base
articles.summary: US personnel were told to take shelter at RAF Lakenheath, a major base hosting American forces in the UK, following "suspected unauthorised drone activity".

articles.title: 'Face' of mystery woman found dead in bin bag in park released by police
articles.summary: The face of a woman whose body was found in a bin bag in a park has been reconstructed as detectives try to identify her.

articles.title: Temperatures drop to -6C with cold weather alert in force in some areas
articles.summary: Temperatures dropped below -6C overnight as parts of the country remain under a cold weather health alert.

articles.title: Jeffrey Donaldson's wife Eleanor placed on sex offenders' register after his rape conviction
articles.summary: Eleanor Donaldson, the wife of disgraced former DUP leader Jeffrey Donaldson, has been placed on the sex offenders' register.
